premises: Dynamic recovery via dislocation climb and subgrain formation is thermally activated and dominates at elevated temperatures and low strain rates in FCC high-entropy alloys.
This dynamic recovery reduces dislocation density and moderates strain hardening, preserving ductility while maintaining strength.
